description.subtitle: Women's T-shirt of the second team adidas of the Argentina 2026 - black
description.tagline: The style of Argentina also in female version
description.intro: The adidas Argentina 2026 shirt from the second women’s outfit is inspired by the creative energy and passion that define Argentine football. Its modern design combines dynamic lines and intense colors that reflect the character of the Albiceleste.
key_benefits: Climatecool technology: Helps keep skin fresh and dry during play.
Fit adapted for women: Comfortable cut designed to offer freedom of movement.
Official design of Argentina: Inspired by the equipment that the selection looks like.
Lightweight and breathable fabric: Ideal for sport or everyday use.

key_benefits: Tecnología Climacool: Ayuda a mantener la piel fresca y seca durante el juego.
Ajuste adaptado para mujer: Corte cómodo pensado para ofrecer libertad de movimiento.
Diseño oficial de Argentina: Inspirado en la equipación que luce la selección.
